mainEntity.name: What is an infinity-edge pool and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: An infinity-edge pool, also known as a vanishing edge or zero-edge pool, creates an illusion of water extending to the horizon or merging with a larger body of water. This effect is achieved by constructing one or more edges slightly lower than the water level, allowing water to flow over the edge into a catch basin below. A recirculation system then pumps this water back into the main pool, maintaining the continuous visual effect. This design element provides a striking aesthetic, especially when positioned with panoramic views, and is a hallmark of luxury outdoor living.
acceptedAnswer.description: An infinity-edge pool features one or more edges that are subtly lower than the water level, creating the illusion of a vanishing horizon as water flows into a hidden catch basin and recirculates.
